text:
Thoughts
expand_more
In Henry Barclay Swete's edition of the Septuagint (The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint, Vol. I: Genesis–IV Kings, 3rd ed., Cambridge, 1901), only the Old Testament passages falling within the Pentateuch (Genesis, Exodus, and Deuteronomy) are contained in this volume
1
. The prophetic books (Hosea, Joel, and Isaiah) are not part of Genesis–IV Kings and therefore are NOT_IN_SOURCE
1
.
Below is the determination and primary-evidence extraction for each of the twelve B001 comparisons.
1. B001-1: Romans 4:3 / Genesis 15:6
Status: TEXT_PRESENT
2
.
Exact Passage / Reference: ΓΕΝΕΣΙΣ (Genesis) 15:6
2
.
Exact Printed Text: καὶ ἐπίστευσεν Ἀβρὰμ τῷ θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.
2
Printed Page / Locator: Page 23
2
.
Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: None
2
.
Exact Apparatus Information: No apparatus entry occurs for verse 6 (the apparatus on page 23 records variants only for chapter 14:20, 21, 23, 24 and chapter 15:1, 7, 10, 12)
2
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish:
Does establish: Unanimous agreement among the extant uncial witnesses collated for this portion of Genesis (Codex Alexandrinus [A] and Codex Cottonianus [D]; Codex Vaticanus [B] has a lacuna here
3
4
) on the printed wording of verse 6
2
.
Does not establish: Any textual doubt, recorded variant, or discussion concerning the Hebrew Masoretic phrasing or the New Testament citation form
2
.
2. B001-2: Romans 9:25 / Hosea 2:23
Status: NOT_IN_SOURCE
1
.
Exact Passage / Reference: Hosea 2:23 (LXX 2:25)
1
.
Exact Printed Text: None (book not present in this volume)
1

Printed Page / Locator: Not in source

Apparatus Entry at Target Wording: Not in source
1

Exact Apparatus Information: None
1
.
What the Apparatus Entry Does and Does Not Establish: Volume I contains only Genesis through IV Kings; the Minor Prophets (including Hosea) belong to Volume III and are completely absent from this source
1
